In `space-in-parens`, with options: `never`

I would expect this code to produce 4 errors, but it produces just 2:

``` js
( ( 1 + 2 ) )
```

For reference, this correctly produces 4 errors

``` js
(  3 * ( 1 + 2 ) + 4 )
```
